MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "None of these items felt like a natural next choice for me right now.",
    "The woodworking glue and hardware assortment have some connection to my recent construction supplies, but that connection alone does not give me a reason to buy them."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "My recent nails, wood screws and drywall anchors serve fastening and mounting tasks; metal-cutting wheels, wiring sleeves and leak-repair putty serve different jobs.",
    "The caliper and thermometer would be useful only if I had a specific measurement task, which my recent purchases do not establish.",
    "The specialized thin woodworking glue does not substitute for construction fasteners, and the eighteen rolls of tape and twelve-pack of glue exceed any bonding need I currently have."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying construction supplies seems to have been taken as interest in almost any workshop or repair product.",
    "My purchases of large packs of fasteners seem to have been treated as a reason to recommend bulk quantities of unrelated supplies."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The repeated purchases of framing nails and wood screws point more specifically toward fastening work than toward general repairs.",
    "Fastener details such as nail collation angle, length, shank type and screw dimensions matter because an otherwise similar item may not fit my tools or job.",
    "My latest vacuum-bag purchase names particular compatible types; it suggests a specific replacement need rather than a general interest in workshop accessories."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize a broad connection to practical supplies but miss the specific fastening tasks and compatibility needs behind my choices."
}
